blocks.text: With Partner and MVNO Settlement, you onboard partners, rate their traffic and produce invoices and settlement reports.

Today, most of them still settle with carriers and partner brands, plus resellers, in spreadsheets, where disputes, late usage records and rate changes cause revenue leakage. **Telecom wholesale billing** on one system closes those gaps.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: Usage records from mediation and charging. Billing for the bill run and invoices.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: **telecom partner management**, revenue share, reseller settlement, partner relationship management (PRM)
Late usage records are still rated, and the adjustments are posted. Rate sheets are kept by prefix and destination, or by pulse.
Rate changes no longer live in spreadsheets.
Monthly commitments and shortfall penalties are applied in the bill run.
Partner brands, resellers and carriers are settled from the same records.
Interconnect invoicing is included. Usage records come from mediation and charging.
MVNEs and host operators use it to bill the MVNOs they carry.

items.a: **Telecom wholesale billing** charges other carriers, MVNOs and resellers for the network capacity and services they use, under the rates and commitments in each agreement.
**Partner settlement** calculates what an operator owes each partner, and what each partner owes the operator, then produces the invoices and reports for both sides.

items.q: Can MVNEs use it to bill the MVNOs they host?
items.a: Yes. MVNEs and host operators bill the MVNOs they carry from the same usage records.
